auth.heroAlt: Five diverse friends cheering over a tropical coastal town at sunset
auth.hook: Think you can out-travel your crew?
auth.birthdayHint: Saved once. Contact support to correct it later. Ages 13 and up can sign up; 13–17 join a trip with their Captain's code and approval.
auth.toSignin: Already have an account? Log in
auth.resetSent: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

error.tooYoung: Family Mode is coming soon. TripJunkies accounts are for ages 13 and up.
error.google: Google sign-in didn't work: {{reason}}. You can also use email below.
error.googlePopup: Google sign-in didn't work: {{reason}}. Pop-ups may be blocked — try again or use email below.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.expired: That code expired ⏰ Tap Resend for a fresh one.
verify.mismatch: Hmm, that code doesn't match 🙈 Double-check it and try again.
verify.spam: Can't find it? Peek in spam or promotions.

roomPlan.readyMadeHint: You get ready-made {{label}} cards to edit or replace. No AI credits used.

roomSetup.preflightDays: Pre-Flight warm-up days before you go (optional)

trip.name: Going on a Trip
trip.line: A group trip, at home or abroad.

window_seat.name: Window Seat
window_seat.line: Travel solo, or with a crew of up to 4.

explore_culture.name: Explore a Culture
explore_culture.line: Bring a culture home: cook it, learn it, play it.

show_culture.name: Show Your Culture
show_culture.line: Share your own culture with your crew.

game_night.name: Game Night
game_night.line: One night of games, any time. Free, no points.

solo.name: Just me
solo.line: Play every day on your own. Crowns come from hitting each season's goal.

crew.name: My crew (on the app)
crew.line: Everyone plays on their own phone and joins with the trip code.

offline.name: Friends off the app
offline.line: One phone runs the games. Names stay on this device; only you earn stamps.

where.title: Where to?
where.focusesHint: Cook it, learn it, wear it, play it.

basics.title: Trip basics
basics.dates: Tap your first and last day
basics.experienceDates: Tap your first and last experience day
basics.name: Trip name
basics.minorsHint: Turns on the family-friendly setup: no party cards, photos visible to leaders and the uploader only.
basics.zoneAsk: This place has more than one time zone. Which one is the trip in?

preflight.title: Pre-Flight
preflight.intro: The run-up before takeoff: quests, daily cards and call nights with your crew.
preflight.skipHint: Skipping means no Early Bird crown.
preflight.nightsHint: Video calls with the crew before the trip. Times are in your time ({{zone}}).
preflight.noNights: Pick at least one Pre-Flight day to add call nights.

season.title: Trip Season
season.intro: From arrival to the last day. It ends with the crowning night, where the Jet Setter is crowned.
season.introHome: Your experience days. They end with the finale night: present, vote, crown.
season.placeHint: A restaurant, the hotel rooftop, someone's living room…
season.callLink: Call link for anyone who can't be there (optional)

invite.title: Invite your crew
invite.offlineHint: First names only. They stay on this phone and nothing is saved for them.
invite.soloLine: Your trip is ready. Play fills in as each phase opens.

problem.name: Give your trip a name.
problem.dates: Tap your first and last day.
problem.datesPast: Pick dates that are still ahead of you.
problem.atHomeTomorrow: At-home experiences start tomorrow at the earliest. For tonight, start a Game Night.
problem.minorsParty: Trips with players under 18 can't use the party vibe.
problem.callNightTime: Pick a day and time for each call night.
problem.callNightWindow: Call nights happen during Pre-Flight, before takeoff day.
problem.callNightPast: Call nights need to be in the future.
problem.crowningDay: It has to be on one of the trip days.
